title: B2B payments, then per invoice
persona: Wholesale distributor who first asks per shop, then realises he chases per invoice.
opening: I want to track payments from my B2B customers.

facts.what to track: how much each owes and when it was paid

success: payments can be tracked against what is owed
the plan is said in plain words before anything is built, with no field names or types
ends by asking whether to build
must_not: a second section for the same payments
jargon such as "boolean" or "set_fields" in what the owner reads
follow_ups: Actually I chase per invoice, not per shop. Make it per order, please.
